lines.text: Hop, hop, hooray! Pippin the bunny found the biggest golden carrot in the forest!
It was sweet, crunchy, and bright orange! Mine, all mine, he cheered!
He hid behind a bush so none of his woodland friends could have a bite!
He took one bite, then two bites... but eating in secret felt strangely quiet!
He looked across the meadow and saw his friends laughing and playing tag!
Pippin carried the big carrot over and snapped it into four juicy slices!
One for squirrel, one for hedgehog, one for puppy, and one for Pippin!
Sharing treats turned a lonely snack into the best picnic ever!
